passages.title: Discussion Chain
passages.content:
Derek Cole [10:04 A.M.]: Hi Claire, did the client from Horizon Media approve the proposed digital banner designs?

Claire Dupont [10:06 A.M.]: Yes, they loved the color scheme, but they asked us to replace the background photograph on the home page slide with an image showing our mobile tablet app.

Derek Cole [10:08 A.M.]: That's an easy fix. I have several high-resolution tablet screenshots in the shared asset folder.

Claire Dupont [10:10 A.M.]: Great! Please export the revised mockups by 1:00 P.M. so I can present them during our afternoon review call.

questions.text: What modification did Horizon Media request?

options.B: Using an image showing a mobile tablet application
options.C: Adding pricing text to all banner slides

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Horizon Media đã yêu cầu chỉnh sửa điều gì?
Bằng chứng: Claire nhắn: "...replace the background photograph on the home page slide with an image showing our mobile tablet app". Chọn (B).

questions.text: At 10:08 A.M., what does Mr. Cole mean when he writes, "That's an easy fix"?

options.A: He has already completed the revision.
options.B: He will have no trouble making the requested change.
options.C: The client agreed to lower their expectations.
options.D: He can borrow an electronic device from a colleague.

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Vào lúc 10:08 sáng, ông Cole có ý gì khi viết "That's an easy fix"?
Bằng chứng: Anh ấy tiếp lời ngay: "I have several high-resolution tablet screenshots in the shared asset folder" cho thấy việc chỉnh sửa rất dễ dàng không gặp trở ngại gì. Chọn (B).

passages.title: Business News
passages.content:
Meridian Logistics Expands Cold-Chain Network

CHICAGO (June 4) — Meridian Logistics, a leading North American transport provider, revealed plans on Tuesday to construct a state-of-the-art temperature-controlled distribution hub in suburban Indianapolis. The 350,000-square-foot facility represents an $85 million investment in the company's expanding refrigerated pharmaceutical supply chain.

Equipped with automated robotic retrieval cranes and advanced climate monitoring sensors, the facility will maintain consistent temperature zones ranging from minus twenty degrees Celsius to ambient storage. Company spokespersons stated that the complex will create approximately 250 skilled logistics jobs upon reaching operational status next spring.

"The surging demand for biologic medicines and vaccine distribution requires unprecedented temperature integrity," said Elena Ortiz, Meridian's Chief Operating Officer. "This new central Midwest hub will enable us to reach over seventy percent of the United States population within twenty-four hours of dispatch." Construction is slated to break ground early next month.

questions.text: What project is Meridian Logistics planning?

options.B: Building a refrigerated distribution center
options.C: Upgrading corporate headquarters offices

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Meridian Logistics đang lên kế hoạch cho dự án nào?
Bằng chứng: "construct a state-of-the-art temperature-controlled distribution hub..." (xây dựng trung tâm phân phối kiểm soát nhiệt độ). Chọn (B) Building a refrigerated distribution center.

questions.text: In the article, the word "integrity" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to

options.B: reliability
options.C: complexity

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Từ "integrity" trong đoạn 3 có nghĩa gần nhất với từ nào?
Bằng chứng: Trong ngữ cảnh "temperature integrity" (sự chuẩn xác, tính ổn định và độ tin cậy về nhiệt độ của chuỗi cung ứng lạnh), từ reliability (độ tin cậy/vững chắc) là tương đương nhất. Chọn (B) reliability.

questions.text: What strategic advantage does Ms. Ortiz mention about the hub's location?

options.B: Ability to reach 70% of the US population within 24 hours
options.C: Exemption from state corporate payroll taxes

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Lợi thế chiến lược nào được bà Ortiz đề cập về vị trí trung tâm?
Bằng chứng: "enable us to reach over seventy percent of the United States population within twenty-four hours of dispatch". Chọn (B).

passages.title: Vendor Selection
passages.content:
To: Department Managers <deptmanagers@crestviewcorp.com>
From: Procurement Committee <procurement@crestviewcorp.com>
Date: July 19
Subject: Adoption of New Cloud Document Collaboration Platform

Dear Colleagues,

Following a rigorous three-month evaluation of enterprise software vendors, the Procurement Committee has selected SyncSphere as our corporation's standardized cloud document collaboration and storage platform, replacing our aging on-premise servers.

SyncSphere was chosen primarily because of its robust end-to-end encryption protocols, intuitive real-time multi-author editing features, and seamless compatibility with our existing mobile devices. [1] Transitioning to this modern cloud solution will streamline cross-departmental project workflows and drastically decrease file synchronization latency. [2]

The data migration process will occur in phased stages over the next four weeks. [3] IT specialists will host mandatory forty-minute interactive orientation webinars next Tuesday and Thursday to introduce employees to folder permission management and digital signature tools. [4] Please review the attached transition timeline document for specific department migration dates.

Sincerely,
Procurement & IT Steering Committee

questions.text: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.A: To announce the adoption of a new software platform
options.B: To solicit feedback on mobile phone models
options.C: To notify employees of office workstation upgrades
options.D: To reprimand staff for data security violations

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Mục đích chính của email là gì?
Bằng chứng: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ: "selected SyncSphere as our corporation's standardized cloud document collaboration and storage platform...". Chọn (A) To announce the adoption of a new software platform.

questions.text: What is NOT mentioned as a reason SyncSphere was chosen?

options.B: Real-time collaborative editing features
options.C: The lowest monthly subscription cost on the market

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Điều gì KHÔNG được đề cập là lý do SyncSphere được chọn?
Bằng chứng: Đoạn 2 liệt kê mã hóa (encryption), chỉnh sửa thời gian thực (real-time editing) và tương thích di động (compatibility with mobile devices). Không hề đề cập đến chi phí rẻ nhất (lowest subscription cost). Chọn (C).

questions.text: What will IT specialists do next week?

options.B: Reinstall operating systems on all computers
options.C: Conduct one-on-one performance reviews
options.D: Shut down the corporate email servers

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Các chuyên gia IT sẽ làm gì vào tuần tới?
Bằng chứng: "IT specialists will host mandatory forty-minute interactive orientation webinars next Tuesday and Thursday...". Chọn (A) Conduct mandatory training webinars.

questions.text:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"During this period, access to legacy network drives will remain functional in read-only mode."
questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Câu "Trong giai đoạn này, quyền truy cập vào các ổ mạng cũ sẽ vẫn duy trì ở chế độ chỉ đọc" phù hợp nhất ở vị trí nào?
Bằng chứng: Vị trí [3] đứng ngay sau câu: "The data migration process will occur in phased stages over the next four weeks." Từ "During this period" quy chiếu trực tiếp đến khoảng thời gian 4 tuần chuyển đổi dữ liệu. Chọn (C) [3].

NEXUS OFFICE SOLUTIONS: RETURN & REFUND POLICY

At Nexus Office Solutions, customer satisfaction is our top priority. If you are not completely satisfied with your commercial furniture or office hardware purchase, please review our standard return procedures below:

• Return Period: Items in original, unused condition with complete packaging may be returned within thirty days of the delivery date for a full refund.
• Damaged Shipments: If merchandise arrives damaged or defective, notify our freight claim desk within 48 hours of receipt. Replacement units will be dispatched without additional shipping charges.
• Custom-Ordered Furniture: Made-to-order conference tables and customized upholstered seating are subject to a twenty percent restocking fee upon return unless arriving damaged.
• Refund Processing: Once returned goods are inspected at our central depot, refunds will be credited to the original form of payment within 5–7 business days.

To initiate a return, visit www.nexusofficesolutions.com/returns to generate a prepaid return shipping label.

passages.title: Architecture News
passages.content:
Kensington Plaza Wins Urban Architecture Award

AUSTIN (November 12) — The Austin Architectural Society announced yesterday that Kensington Plaza has received the prestigious 2026 Commercial Design of the Year Award. Designed by local architectural collective Studio Forma, the twelve-story mixed-use development seamlessly integrates corporate office suites, street-level retail shops, and an expansive public rooftop botanical garden.

The judging committee commended the building's pioneering environmental design. [1] Powered by over two thousand photovoltaic solar roof panels, Kensington Plaza generates more than thirty percent of its own operational electricity. [2] In addition, a sophisticated subterranean rainwater harvesting filtration system irrigates the building's landscaped terraces and rooftop trees. [3]

"Our objective from the inception of the blueprint was to create an urban workspace that fosters community connection while minimizing energy footprint," said Marcus Vance, lead architect at Studio Forma. [4] Since its grand opening last January, Kensington Plaza has achieved full commercial occupancy, with anchor tenants including major financial consultancies and healthcare innovators.

questions.text: What honor did Kensington Plaza receive?

options.B: The Commercial Design of the Year Award
options.C: A municipal energy tax reduction grant
options.D: An international real estate investment trophy

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Tòa nhà Kensington Plaza đã nhận được vinh dự nào?
Bằng chứng: Đoạn 1 nêu: "Kensington Plaza has received the prestigious 2026 Commercial Design of the Year Award". Chọn (B).

questions.text: According to the article, what is true about the building's energy usage?

options.A: It relies entirely on wind turbine generators.
options.B: It generates over 30% of its own electricity through solar panels.
options.C: It shares an electric power grid with adjacent universities.
options.D: It reduced electricity consumption by 50% during winter.

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Theo bài báo, điều gì đúng về mức sử dụng năng lượng của tòa nhà?
Bằng chứng: "generates more than thirty percent of its own operational electricity". Chọn (B).

questions.text: What does the article mention about Kensington Plaza since January?

options.B: Its construction budget was reduced by 15%.
options.C: It opened a new public transit station.

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Bài báo đề cập điều gì về Kensington Plaza kể từ tháng Giêng?
Bằng chứng: Đoạn cuối: "Since its grand opening last January, Kensington Plaza has achieved full commercial occupancy..." (đã đạt tỷ lệ lấp đầy thương mại 100%). Chọn (A).

questions.text:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"These sustainable features reduce municipal water consumption by nearly forty percent annually."
questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Câu "Những đặc tính bền vững này giúp giảm lượng nước tiêu thụ từ thành phố tới gần 40% mỗi năm" phù hợp nhất ở vị trí nào?
Bằng chứng: Câu đứng trước vị trí [3] vừa đề cập đến hệ thống lọc thu gom nước mưa tưới cây: "subterranean rainwater harvesting filtration system irrigates the building's landscaped terraces and rooftop trees". Câu chèn vào tổng kết lợi ích giảm tiêu thụ nước thành phố. Do đó vị trí [3] là hoàn hảo. Chọn (C) [3].

passages.title: Client Feedback Form
passages.content:
Customer Service Review: MetroLink Cloud Storage
Submitted by: Angela Hughes, IT Director, Summit Financial
Date: October 14 | Overall Rating: 3 out of 5 stars

Summit Financial migrated approximately twelve terabytes of historical financial records to MetroLink's Cloud Enterprise Tier last month. The migration process itself was relatively seamless, and our daily data access speeds have been consistently high.

However, we experienced significant friction regarding monthly billing invoices. Our initial sales agreement included a 15% promotional volume discount for our first year of service. Yet, both our September and October invoices were billed at the standard rate of $1,200 per month without applying the deduction. When I phoned customer support on October 8, the representative informed me that the billing ticket would be reviewed within 24 hours, but I have not received any follow-up correspondence. I expect our billing records to be reconciled promptly.

passages.title: Executive Resolution
passages.content:
To: Angela Hughes <ahughes@summitfinancial.com>
From: Daniel Foster, Vice President of Client Accounts
Date: October 16
Subject: Resolution of Billing Adjustment — Account #MF-8842

Dear Ms. Hughes,

Thank you for bringing your billing concern to our leadership team's attention. I reviewed your account history and discovered that while your promotional volume discount was correctly approved during sales onboarding, our automated accounting billing system failed to apply the code to your recurring billing profile.

I have manually corrected this error. Your account has been credited $360 to cover the overcharged amounts from September and October ($180 per month). Furthermore, your November statement will reflect your discounted rate of $1,020 per month for the remainder of your annual contract.

I also apologize for the lack of communication following your support call on October 8. Our support management has instituted a mandatory ticket escalation policy to ensure that enterprise clients receive status updates within four business hours. To express our gratitude for your patience, we have enabled three months of complimentary advanced data encryption backup valued at $150 per month.

Sincerely,
Daniel Foster
MetroLink Cloud Services

questions.text: What positive aspect of MetroLink's service did Ms. Hughes mention?

options.B: Extremely affordable hardware repair costs
options.C: Free 24-hour telephone customer assistance

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Khía cạnh tích cực nào của dịch vụ MetroLink được cô Hughes đề cập?
Bằng chứng: Trong bài đánh giá, cô Hughes nhận xét: "our daily data access speeds have been consistently high" (tốc độ truy cập dữ liệu hàng ngày luôn ở mức cao). Chọn (A) Consistently fast data access speeds.

questions.text: What was the main reason for Ms. Hughes's complaint?

options.B: Failure to apply an agreed promotional discount to invoices
options.C: An unscheduled server outage during market trading hours
options.D: Difficulty installing software on employee laptops

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Lý do chính khiến cô Hughes phàn nàn là gì?
Bằng chứng: Cô Hughes nêu rõ: "both our September and October invoices were billed at the standard rate... without applying the deduction" (cả hóa đơn tháng 9 và tháng 10 đều tính theo giá tiêu chuẩn mà không áp dụng giảm giá). Chọn (B).

questions.text: In the email, what explanation does Mr. Foster give for the billing mistake?

options.A: The client provided an invalid corporate credit card.
options.B: The automated billing system failed to apply the discount code.
options.C: The promotional period expired earlier than scheduled.
options.D: An accounting employee entered incorrect bank account information.

questions.explanation:

passages.title: Relocation Announcement
passages.content:
INTERNAL MEMO: FACILITY EXPANSION SEARCH
To: Executive Leadership Committee
From: Beatrice Holloway, Chief Operations Officer
Date: May 2 | Subject: Downtown Office Relocation Criteria

Due to the hiring of thirty software engineers over the past two quarters, our current office at Parkview Center has reached maximum occupancy. The facilities committee has outlined criteria for our new corporate headquarters:

1. Total usable floor area between 25,000 and 30,000 square feet.
2. Location within four blocks of an express subway station.
3. Minimum of 60 dedicated parking spaces for staff.
4. Building must hold LEED Gold or Platinum green energy certification.

We have retained Commercial Property Associates to identify prospective leasehold candidates.

passages.title: Agent Proposal
passages.content:
To: Beatrice Holloway <bholloway@vanguardsoft.com>
From: Gregory Sullivan, Senior Broker, CPA Realty
Date: May 10
Subject: Prospective Properties for Vanguard Software

Dear Ms. Holloway,

Based on your stated relocation criteria, we have evaluated commercial properties across the Financial District. We identified two strong contenders: the Meridian Commerce Tower and the Trinity Exchange Building.

While the Meridian Tower offers 32,000 square feet, it only has 40 parking stalls. In contrast, the Trinity Exchange Building (floors 6 through 8) offers exactly 28,500 square feet, 75 underground parking spots, and sits just two blocks from City Hall Metro Station. It also received LEED Platinum certification last year.

The landlord has authorized an on-site building inspection this Thursday at 10:00 A.M. I have commissioned Apex Engineering to inspect the building's structural and climate control systems beforehand.

Best regards,
Gregory Sullivan

passages.title: Inspection Summary
passages.content:
APEX ENGINEERING: PRE-LEASE INSPECTION AUDIT
Property: Trinity Exchange Building (Floors 6–8)
Inspected By: Ronald Chang, PE | Date: May 12

Executive Findings:
• Structural & Electrical: The electrical wiring, backup generators, and fiber-optic telecommunication cables are in pristine condition, supporting high-density server racks.
• Climate Controls (HVAC): The primary air-handling units servicing floor 7 were modernized in 2024, providing excellent filtration.
• Minor Recommendation: Several emergency exit signs on the 8th floor require battery replacement, which the building manager agreed to rectify within 48 hours.
• Conclusion: The property exceeds standard commercial standards and is fully ready for tenant occupancy.

questions.text: Why is Vanguard Software planning to relocate?

options.A: Its existing office lease has been cancelled.
options.B: Its current facility has reached maximum occupancy.
options.C: It wants to downsize operational staff.
options.D: It needs to reduce monthly rental expenditures.

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Tại sao Vanguard Software lên kế hoạch chuyển văn phòng?
Bằng chứng: Trong bản ghi nhớ, bà Holloway giải thích: "Due to the hiring of thirty software engineers... our current office at Parkview Center has reached maximum occupancy". Chọn (B).

options.B: It does not provide enough parking spaces.
options.C: It is located too far from the financial district.
options.D: It lacks LEED green building certification.

Dịch nghĩa: Tại sao ông Sullivan đánh giá Meridian Commerce Tower ít phù hợp hơn?
Bằng chứng: Tiêu chí yêu cầu tối thiểu 60 chỗ đỗ xe. Ông Sullivan chỉ ra: "While the Meridian Tower offers 32,000 square feet, it only has 40 parking stalls" (chỉ có 40 chỗ đỗ). Chọn (B).

questions.text: How much usable floor space does the Trinity Exchange Building provide?

options.B: 28,500 square feet
options.C: 30,000 square feet

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Tòa nhà Trinity Exchange cung cấp diện tích sàn sử dụng là bao nhiêu?
Bằng chứng: Email của ông Sullivan nêu rõ: "the Trinity Exchange Building (floors 6 through 8) offers exactly 28,500 square feet...". Chọn (B) 28,500 square feet.

options.A: Replacing batteries in emergency exit signs
options.B: Repairing leaking water pipes on the 6th floor
options.C: Upgrading backup power diesel generators

questions.explanation:
Dịch nghĩa: Sửa chữa nhỏ nào được khuyến nghị trong báo cáo kiểm định?
Bằng chứng: Mục Minor Recommendation trong báo cáo ghi: "Several emergency exit signs on the 8th floor require battery replacement...". Chọn (A).

questions.text: What is indicated about the Trinity Exchange Building in all three documents?

options.A: It was constructed within the past two years.

Bằng chứng: Đối chiếu tiêu chí trong Memo (25k-30k sq ft, gần metro, >60 chỗ đỗ, LEED Gold/Platinum), email của môi giới (28.5k sq ft, 2 block từ metro, 75 chỗ đỗ, LEED Platinum), và báo cáo kiểm định kỹ thuật (hoàn hảo sẵn sàng sử dụng). Tòa nhà đáp ứng trọn vẹn mọi tiêu chí của công ty. Chọn (B).

passages.title: Schedule Revision
passages.content:
CONFERENCE ORGANIZING COMMITTEE — URGENT NOTICE
To: All Registered Delegates
Date: October 22 | Subject: Program Revision for Morning Sessions

Please be advised that Dr. Alan Chen has unfortunately been called away for emergency medical duties and cannot deliver the opening keynote speech on Friday, October 26.

In light of this change, Ms. Fiona Gallagher has graciously agreed to move her presentation on "Cloud Security for Electronic Health Records" into the 9:00 A.M. keynote slot in the Grand Ballroom. Consequently, Dr. Brody's session in Room 105 will now be the sole breakout presentation at 10:30 A.M., allowing all delegates to attend without scheduling conflicts. Attendees who originally signed up for Dr. Chen's session are invited to download his research paper from the conference app.

passages.content:

Date: October 24
Subject: Friday's Healthcare Informatics Congress in San Diego

Hi Sofia,

I reviewed the revised schedule for this Friday's congress. Since Ms. Gallagher's cloud security presentation was moved to the opening keynote, this works out conveniently for our schedule! Kevin
